reason: A client-only DSH plugin that adds configurable automatic and full collapse behavior for the left conversation sidebar, with persisted browser preferences and no model-context or telemetry interaction.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 左侧会话侧栏提供可配置的自动收起和完全隐藏功能，并保留用户的浏览器偏好设置。
summaries.en: Adds configurable automatic and full-collapse controls for the DSH left conversation sidebar while preserving the user’s browser preferences.

capabilities: Modifies the DSH browser sidebar layout
Automatically collapses the sidebar when selecting a conversation
Persists user preferences in browser localStorage
Adds a floating control to restore the fully collapsed sidebar
